title: A Cold Day in the Park
text:
Anna looks at the window. It is cold and it is raining. She puts on a warm coat and a hat. She takes an umbrella too.

Today Anna wears blue boots. Her brother wears a red jacket and jeans. They go out to the park. It is cold, but they are happy.

questions.text: What is the weather like in paragraph one?
Why does Anna take an umbrella?
How do Anna and her brother probably feel at the park?

vocabulary.definition: a long warm piece of clothing worn outside
an object you hold above your head to stay dry in the rain
strong shoes that cover the foot and part of the leg

paragraph_translations: Анна дивиться у вікно. Надворі холодно і йде дощ. Вона одягає тепле пальто і капелюх. Вона також бере парасольку.
Сьогодні Анна носить сині черевики. Її брат носить червону куртку і джинси. Вони йдуть до парку. Холодно, але вони щасливі.
